mapper.sql: id, event_id, tenant_id, task_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, topic_name, partition_key, payload, trace_id, status, attempt_count, max_attempts, next_retry_at, lease_owner, lease_until, heartbeat_at, fencing_token, row_version, error_message, published_at, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId, event_id AS eventId FROM rag_outbox WHERE deleted = 0 AND ( status = 'pending' OR (status = 'retrying' AND next_retry_at IS NOT NULL AND next_retry_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'publishing' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until <= #{now}) ) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_outbox ( event_id, tenant_id, task_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, topic_name, partition_key, payload, trace_id, status, attempt_count, max_attempts, next_retry_at, lease_owner, lease_until, heartbeat_at, fencing_token, row_version, error_message, published_at ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{tenantId}, #{taskId}, COALESCE(#{aggregateType}, 'rag_ingest_task'), #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{topicName}, #{partitionKey}, #{payload}, #{traceId}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'pending'), COALESCE(#{attemptCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{maxAttempts}, 10), #{nextRetryAt}, #{leaseOwner}, #{leaseUntil}, #{heartbeatAt}, COALESCE(#{fencingToken}, 0), COALESCE(#{rowVersion}, 0), #{errorMessage}, #{publishedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM rag_outbox WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM rag_outbox WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE rag_outbox SET status = 'publishing', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, next_retry_at = NULL, lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, heartbeat_at = #{now}, fencing_token = fencing_token + 1, row_version = row_version + 1, error_message = NULL WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND deleted = 0 AND attempt_count < max_attempts AND ( status = 'pending' OR (status = 'retrying' AND next_retry_at IS NOT NULL AND next_retry_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'publishing' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until <= #{now}) )

UPDATE rag_outbox SET status = 'published', next_retry_at = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, heartbeat_at = NULL, error_message = NULL, published_at = #{publishedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'publishing' AND lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND fencing_token = #{fencingToken} AND lease_until >= #{publishedAt} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE rag_outbox SET status = 'retrying', next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, heartbeat_at = NULL, error_message = #{errorMessage}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'publishing' AND lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND fencing_token = #{fencingToken} AND lease_until >= #{now} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE rag_outbox SET status = 'dead', next_retry_at = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, heartbeat_at = NULL, error_message = #{errorMessage}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'publishing' AND lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND fencing_token = #{fencingToken} AND lease_until >= #{now} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE rag_outbox SET status = 'dead', next_retry_at = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, heartbeat_at = NULL, error_message = #{errorMessage}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND deleted = 0 AND status IN ('pending', 'retrying') AND attempt_count >= max_attempts
